name: 1social-scheduler
description: A content calendar workflow for the 1Social connector: plan a week of posts across the user's connected social networks, write a caption for each network, check every post against its limits, and schedule them all.

interface.longDescription:
Plan and schedule a week of social media posts in one conversation. Tell it what you want to talk about and how often, and get a content calendar across the networks you have connected: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Threads. Each post gets a caption written for its network, with hashtags where they help, and is checked against that network's limits before anything is scheduled. Review the calendar as a table, change what you like, then schedule everything up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

Publishing happens on 1Social's side, so nothing needs to stay open. Ask later to see the queue, move a post or cancel one.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need at least one social account connected to your 1Social account.
capabilities: Bulk scheduling up to 30 days ahead
defaultPrompt: Plan next week's social media posts about our product and schedule them.
Make a content calendar with three posts a week for LinkedIn and X.
Show me what's scheduled this week and move Friday's post to Monday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: a guided content calendar and bulk scheduling over the 1Social connector.
